title: AgentSkin Verification Contract
description: Declarative contract describing how to verify that an adapter injection succeeded in the target DOM. Uses three-level semantics: required (must pass), recommended (warn on failure), contexts (conditional checks).

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor validation

targets.description: Per-adapter verification contracts keyed by adapter id

verification.description: Three-level verification contract for a single adapter

required.description: Checks that must pass for the injection to be considered successful

recommended.description: Checks that should pass but are not deal-breakers (produce warnings)

contexts.description: Conditional checks — only evaluated when the context's 'when' selector matches

any.description: List of CSS selectors — at least one must match in the DOM snapshot

provenance.description: Evidence source and coverage metadata for a check. Optional — checks without provenance still validate but produce a warning in CI.

source.description: Evidence source: maintainer (known contract), reporter (user report), fixture (test fixture), inferred (derived from other evidence), reverse-engineering (derived from binary/static analysis of target application)

strength.description: Evidence strength: strong (verified in production), medium (verified in fixture), weak (unverified or heuristic)

knownGaps.description: Known coverage gaps — scenarios where this check may not hold

coveredVersions.description: Application versions where this check has been verified

lastVerified.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) when this check was last verified

required.description: Checks that must pass when this context is active

whenClause.description: Condition that activates the context — at least one selector must match
